PO.Data: Tables and processes of the centralized ID management service (CGI replacement)
Groups the dictionary records that back the Centralized ID Management plugin: per-table ID counters and the log of every ID delivered.
Counters hold the last ID delivered per table. The log tab lists every ID delivered, with the reason given by the requester.
Read-only view of the centralized ID counters and the log of delivered IDs
Vista de solo lectura de los contadores de ID centralizado y del registro de IDs entregados
Los contadores guardan el último ID entregado por tabla. La pestaña de solicitudes lista cada ID entregado con el motivo indicado por quien lo pidió.
Last ID delivered by the centralized ID service for each table
One row per table name. CurrentID holds the last ID delivered to a requester; the service increments it atomically.
Log of every ID delivered by the centralized ID service
One row per ID delivered: the counter it came from, the ID, the reason given by the requester. The requester is the record creator.

A Client is a company or a legal entity. You cannot share data between Clients. Tenant is a synonym for Client.
The record is active in the system

There are two methods of making records unavailable in the system: One is to delete the record, the other is to de-activate the record. A de-activated record is not available for selection, but available for reports. There are two reasons for de-activating and not deleting records: (1) The system requires the record for audit purposes. (2) The record is referenced by other records. E.g., you cannot delete a Business Partner, if there are invoices for this partner record existing. You de-activate the Business Partner and prevent that this record is used for future entries.
